definitions.explanation: Describes doing something without deliberate awareness or intention. The action happens automatically or out of habit.

examples.japanese: {無意識|むいしき}に⟦{口|くち}ずさんでいた→口ずさむ：18513_kuchizusamu⟧。
examples.english: I was humming without realizing it.
He has a habit of touching his hair without thinking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{緊張|きんちょう}する→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{無意識|むいしき}に⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}らして→揺らす：02479_yurasu⟧しまう。
examples.english: When I get nervous, I involuntarily shake my leg.

notes:
Describes actions performed without the person being aware of doing them. The underlying noun ⟦{無意識|むいしき}→無意識：05813_muishiki⟧ means 'the unconscious' or 'unconsciousness,' and can also be used as a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-adjective.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無意識|むいしき}に⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧: one's body moves involuntarily
- ⟦{無意識|むいしき}→無意識：05813_muishiki⟧のうち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: without realizing it
- {無意識|むいしき}に⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧: to avoid unconsciously
- {無意識|むいしき}に⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧: to repeat unconsciously

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず: involuntarily, unintentionally — emphasizes a spontaneous reaction to a stimulus
- {何気|なにげ}なく: casually, without particular intent — lighter; the person may be vaguely aware but not focused
- ⟦{知|し}ら→知る：00458_shiru⟧ず⟦{知|し}ら→知る：00458_shiru⟧ずのうち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: without knowing it — more literary; emphasizes gradual, unnoticed change
